_note: DEV FALLBACK only. In production the operator's /var/lib/blockle-biz/buy-config.json (same file the site /api/buy/config serves) is the source of truth. Addresses here are TESTNET placeholders — replace reserveAddr with your Base Sepolia USDC reserve and blockReserveAddr with your reserve wallet's BLOCK address. Curve params mirror web/buy.js defaults exactly; do not invent numbers.
_curves_note: Dedicated curves selectable by name via ?curve=<name>, SEPARATE from the main curve above.
